sections.title: Denver Industry Specializations
sections.description: Deep expertise in Denver's key industry verticals.

blocks.heading: Aerospace and Defense (Colorado Space Command)
paragraphs: The Denver metro — specifically the 'Space Corridor' along US-25 from Broomfield to Centennial — is one of the US's most significant space industry locations:
Lockheed Martin Space (Littleton CO HQ) — GPS satellites, space exploration, missile defense.
Raytheon Intelligence & Space (Aurora CO) — satellite systems, space sensing.
United Launch Alliance (Centennial CO) — commercial launch services.
Ball Aerospace (Boulder, 35 miles) — satellite instruments and systems.
ClickMasters builds commercial AI for this community's non-classified business operations:
Manufacturing quality inspection for aerospace component production.
Supply chain analytics for the complex multi-tier space industry supply chain.
Business intelligence and operational analytics for commercial space technology companies.
Classified and ITAR-restricted technical work is outside ClickMasters' scope.
Cost: $50,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks

blocks.heading: Energy (Colorado's Fossil and Renewable Mix)
paragraphs: Denver is the operating headquarters for Colorado's significant oil and gas industry (DJ Basin, Wattenberg Gas Field), natural gas midstream operations, and a growing renewable energy sector:

Oil and gas production analytics: DJ Basin well performance prediction, production optimization, and waterflood management analytics for Denver's upstream operators (Civitas Resources, Bonanza Creek).
Natural gas pipeline analytics: Midstream operations AI for Denver's pipeline and gathering companies (Crestwood Midstream, DCP Midstream, now Phillips 66 Partners).

Renewable energy: Solar and wind operations analytics for Colorado's rapidly growing renewable energy sector — Xcel Energy's Colorado operations include one of the US's largest state-level renewable energy programs.
Cost: $45,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Healthcare
paragraphs: UCHealth (Denver HQ, Colorado's leading academic health system), Centura Health (Englewood CO), and SCL Health (now merged with Intermountain). HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Denver's major health systems.
Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Outdoor and Lifestyle
paragraphs: REI's largest US market, VF Corporation's Denver operations, and the ski resort technology community (Vail Resorts' Broomfield HQ):
Outdoor retail demand forecasting incorporating weather, snow conditions, and Colorado's distinct outdoor season patterns.
Ski resort operations analytics — snowmaking optimization, lift capacity, and dynamic pricing for Vail's Epic Pass resort portfolio.
DTC analytics for outdoor brands selling direct-to-consumer from Denver's growing outdoor retail market.
Cost: $35,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

sections.title: Colorado AI Regulatory Context
sections.description: Key legal and compliance considerations for Denver AI development.

blocks.heading: Colorado Privacy Act (CPA)
paragraphs: Colorado's consumer privacy law (effective July 2023) creates consumer data rights applicable to Denver's consumer-facing AI — ClickMasters designs Denver AI with CPA compliance.

blocks.heading: Colorado AI Act (SB21-169 and HB24-1468)
paragraphs: Colorado has enacted both insurance AI fairness requirements and broader AI regulations — ClickMasters designs Denver AI with Colorado's AI legislative framework, which is among the most active in the Mountain West.

items.question: Can ClickMasters build commercial AI for Lockheed Martin's Colorado Space operations?
items.answer: Yes — non-classified commercial operations AI for Lockheed Martin Space's Littleton campus is a ClickMasters capability. Direct engagement depends on Lockheed's vendor qualification processes.

items.question: Can ClickMasters build ski resort operations AI for Vail Resorts?
items.answer: Yes — snowmaking optimization, lift capacity analytics, and dynamic pricing AI for Vail's Colorado resort portfolio are ClickMasters capabilities.

items.question: Does ClickMasters understand Colorado's AI legislation?
items.answer: Yes — Colorado Privacy Act and Colorado's SB21-169 insurance AI fairness requirements are specific design inputs for Denver AI.

items.question: Does ClickMasters work Mountain Time for Denver?
items.answer: Yes — Mountain Time (MDT/MST) is standard for Denver and Colorado engagements.
